description.value: Abaco Health is a locally and family-owned natural health products retailer in Kelowna that has been serving the community since 2005, with qualified nutritionists on staff. The store stocks an extensive range of vitamins, minerals, supplements, sports nutrition products (electrolytes, protein powders, amino acids), and natural snacks that could be of interest to cyclists looking to restock on energy and recovery products. It operates both a physical storefront and an online shop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Abaco Health is an active, locally and family-owned natural health products and supplement retail store in Kelowna, operating since 2005 with qualified nutritionists on staff. The website consistently advertises a toll-free number (1-877-861-3090) that differs from the local number in OSM (+1 250-861-3090), which is flagged as a concern. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all such fields remain null.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1 250-861-3090 (local), but the website consistently advertises the toll-free number 1-877-861-3090 as the primary contact. The local number may still be valid but was not confirmed on the website.
Category fit is weak: this is primarily a supplement/natural health products retailer, not a conventional grocery store — category may mislead cyclists expecting standard food resupply.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Abaco Health is a legitimate, active physical retail store that stocks sports nutrition, electrolytes, and snacks relevant to cyclists, but it is primarily a supplement and natural health products store rather than a grocery resupply point. No cycling amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are documented. Human review should confirm whether the sports nutrition and snack selection is sufficient to justify a 'Groceries' directory listing for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website content was heavily dominated by navigation and product category menus; the About and Contact subpages were truncated before any address or additional contact details could be confirmed.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM categorizes this as a health_food shop. The store primarily sells vitamins, supplements, and natural health products with a secondary offering of snacks and sports nutrition — it is not a conventional grocery store. A category of 'Health & Specialty Food' or 'Supplements/Health Store' would be more accurate, but it is retained here as provided.
